name: lens
description: lens: the screenshot, not the pixels. A whole-image Read over 1024 px comes back downscaled (JPEG q85, the size a model actually reads), with the tokens kept out on the line; optional starlens certificate that the answer survived.

max_edge.title: Longest edge
max_edge.description: Images with a longer edge than this are downscaled before the model sees them (default 1024).

quality.title: JPEG quality
quality.description: JPEG quality for the downscaled image (default 85).

min_bytes.title: Minimum size
min_bytes.description: Images smaller than this many bytes pass through untouched (default 60000).
